stem:
Krish writes process cards for a green leaf in sunlight and for the same leaf using stored food.

Which claim keeps photosynthesis and respiration distinct?

options.text: Photosynthesis builds glucose and oxygen using sunlight and chlorophyll; respiration breaks glucose with oxygen to release energy.
Photosynthesis builds glucose and oxygen in complete darkness the same way as in sunlight.
Photosynthesis breaks glucose with oxygen to release energy; respiration builds glucose and oxygen.
Respiration builds glucose and oxygen and stores energy in the glucose.

teacher.key_rationale: Photosynthesis makes glucose and oxygen with sunlight and chlorophyll; respiration uses glucose and oxygen to release energy. Darkness drops the sunlight condition; swapping the two processes or treating respiration as the maker of glucose conflates them.
